intent: Less-travelled dialect: sankey-beta. Wave 1 covered none of the beta dialects except xychart. Probes whether the type normaliser knows sankey-beta at all (wave 1 found stateDiagram-v2 had NO normaliser registered), and whether sankey's auto-assigned node/link colors are theme-aware - sankey links are drawn semi-transparent by default, which is exactly the alpha-blend case this wave targets.
